data.cultural_impact: The name "Bharatva" carries a deep cultural significance as it is derived from the revered ancient Sanskrit epic, Mahabharata, which is one of the two major Sanskrit epics of ancient India. The name "Bharat" is given to the eldest brother and natural heir to the throne of the Kuru dynasty, who is also known as Arjuna. Thus, the name "Bharatva" signifies a leader who comes from a lineage of great rulers and follows the path of righteousness and dharma to govern and protect his people.
